neighbours.label: things changing or differing from how they were ('things changed', 'change his mind', 'this time was different')
fire: Everything changed for her after the fire at the mill.
He will surely change his mind about the farm next year.
But this winter was different, and the village knew it.
Perhaps her opinion could change once she meets them.
Our situation is different from the one in your town.
They changed their minds about the wedding at the last minute.
Su opinión es diferente a la de sus padres.
Life changed quickly when the railroad came to the valley.
quiet: Everything stayed quiet for her after the fire at the mill.
He will surely read his book about the farm next year.
But this winter was the same, and the village knew it.
Perhaps her sister could come once she meets them.
Our situation is like the one in your town.
They kept their plans for the wedding at the last minute.
Su casa es igual a la de sus padres.
Life went on slowly when the railroad came to the valley.
